_meta.name: AA-PRE-2 credential-class allow-set
_meta.policy: 5-pair allow-set. Any (actorType, credentialClass) pair NOT present here is rejected by AA-1 verifier rule 5. This file is the single source of truth for cross-repo consumers (e.g. the Python `solo-builder-core` repo's `_VALID_PAIRS` constant) — narrowing or widening either side without updating this snapshot in the same change is a structural-correctness violation.
_meta.devImpersonationRuntimeGate: The pair ("human", "dev_impersonation") is permitted at the matrix layer but MUST be rejected in production by the caller (signer `isProduction` flag, or verifier env-aware caller). The matrix is type-level, not env-aware. Cross-repo consumers MUST replicate this caller-side gate; the JSON cannot encode it.
_meta.regenerationDiscipline: If `CREDENTIAL_CLASS_MATRIX` in `credential-class-matrix.ts` ever changes (additive only — see file header), this snapshot MUST update in the same commit. `tests/credential-class-matrix.test.ts` asserts byte-equality between the two and fails the build on drift.
